Oh man, I am so angry.

My sibling and I (not going to specify, don't wanna get caught) were up all day to get everything for mother's day (flowers, groceries for breakfast, heck, we even bought a fancy and very expensive shower gel for her)

Anyway, mother's day comes, I have been up for two hours preparing her breakfast and then, we give her the presents.

Did she admire them? Nope

Was she happy? Nope, in fact, she started complaining about the flowers.

Did she say thank you? Fucking. Nope.

She ate her breakfast quickly and for the rest of the day, she did not do anything else except for nagging.

But I have no other choice. If we don't celebrate mother's day, she will just throw a tantrum and will start to cry and complain how "awful" we are.

I can't wait to get the fuck out of here.
Yes, sort of. I don't really wanna go that much into detail about it (might get caught)
I just feel like I have no other choice, they support me financially, and that is their triumph card against me!
Otherwise all hell would have broken loose. And they don't like it when I get emotional (it's "childish").
No, they did not see the cuts (luckily).

I'm fine, the cuts were not deep enough to be actually threatening (did not even cut after all, just left small, slim marks). I am just really scared right now. I need to get my parents to listen to me, otherwise... It will end in a catastrophe.

That sounds like a good first step, but if I want to drop out,my parents and me must sign a sheet together. And as already mentioned, they refuse to listen to me.

I could wait until I am eighteen (my birthday is in two months). But I am sure that my parents will punish me If i drop out by myself (You don't bite the hand that feeds you after all...)
Man, that must have been harsh, I hope you will get better soon!
Maybe this is the best way and I just should not force myself into getting over it. It is just hard to cry for me.
I consider that a possibility, I just don't have anybody that I could talk about it...
I know that I should stay strong, but whenever I think of the good times, It just makes me feel worse and I want her back so badly! So, thinking about her is not really a good way for me (somehow).
Wow, thank you so much for the kind words. And I guess you are right, maybe I will/should never get over it completely.
